result.title: RiDEx: Reward-Informed Directional Exploration for Diffusion Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Reward-based diffusion post-training updates model parameters from task rewards. While existing approaches improve sampling and policy optimization, they still rely largely on isotropic random perturbations in a high-dimensional latent space for exploration. Such variation often spends the perturbation budget on changes with little influence on the target reward, making exploration inefficient. We study where diffusion models should explore and how to learn from that exploration. We introduce Reward-Informed Directional Exploration (RiDEx), which concentrates local exploration in reward-relevant subspaces of the denoising velocity field. Conditional residuals or differentiable reward gradients propose the subspace, and equal-and-opposite perturbations at the same generation state measure its terminal reward response. The reward difference supplies signed local supervision in the explored coordinates, while all generated images contribute to global DiffusionNFT learning. RiDEx thereby couples exploration-space selection with feedback about the changes it produces. On Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium, RiDEx attains the highest peak rewards among the evaluated methods on four alignment and preference tasks. Its gradient-direction instantiation achieves 15x and 29x target-attainment speedups over DiffusionNFT on HPSv2 and PickScore, measured in H200 GPU hours. Controlled experiments confirm that reward-aligned directions elicit stronger responses at equal perturbation magnitude, and that applying their measured credit improves curve-average reward across all four tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RiDEx，在扩散模型去噪速度场中把局部探索集中到与奖励相关的子空间，并在同一生成状态施加等量反向扰动，以终端奖励差作为有符号局部监督，再结合全局 DiffusionNFT 学习。
AI.relevance_reason: 「同状态反向扰动—终端奖励差」的局部信用分配思路可能可供核查 latent 推理中单个状态或方向对最终答案的因果贡献；但对象是图像生成，与 VLM 推理的联系尚需判断。
